title_en: Regulations on the Administration of Environmental Protection of Construction Projects

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Regulations are formulated to prevent new pollution and ecological damage caused by construction projects.

Article 2 These Regulations shall apply to construction projects with environmental impact within the territory of the People's Republic of China and other sea areas under the jurisdiction of the People's Republic of China.

Article 3 Construction projects that cause pollution must comply with the national and local standards for pollutant discharge; in areas where total discharge control of key pollutants is implemented, they must also meet the requirements for total discharge control of key pollutants.

Article 4 Industrial construction projects shall adopt clean production processes with low energy and material consumption and low pollutant generation, rationally utilize natural resources, and prevent environmental pollution and ecological damage.
Article 5 Reconstruction, expansion, and technological transformation projects must take measures to control the existing environmental pollution and ecological damage related to such projects.
Article 6 The State shall implement a system of environmental impact assessment for construction projects.

Article 9 For a construction project that shall, according to law, prepare an environmental impact report or an environmental impact statement, the construction entity shall, before commencing construction, submit the environmental impact report or environmental impact statement to the competent department of environmental protection with the power of approval for examination and approval; if the environmental impact assessment document of the construction project has not been examined according to law by the approving department or has not been approved after examination, the construction entity shall not commence construction.
When examining and approving an environmental impact report or environmental impact statement, the competent department of environmental protection shall focus on reviewing the environmental feasibility of the construction project, the reliability of the environmental impact analysis, prediction, and assessment, the effectiveness of environmental protection measures, the scientific nature of the environmental impact assessment conclusion, etc., and shall make a decision on approval and notify the construction entity in writing within 60 days from the date of receipt of the environmental impact report, and within 30 days from the date of receipt of the environmental impact statement.
The competent department of environmental protection may organize technical institutions to conduct technical assessments of the environmental impact report or environmental impact statement of the construction project, and shall bear the corresponding costs; the technical institution shall be responsible for the technical assessment opinions it issues, and shall not charge any fees to the construction entity or the unit engaged in environmental impact assessment work.
For a construction project that shall, according to law, fill in an environmental impact registration form, the construction entity shall, in accordance with the provisions of the competent department of environmental protection under the State Council, submit the environmental impact registration form to the competent department of environmental protection at the county level in the location of the construction project for recordation.
The competent department of environmental protection shall carry out online approval, recordation, and information disclosure of environmental impact assessment documents.

Article 12 After the environmental impact report or environmental impact statement of a construction project has been approved, if there are major changes in the nature, scale, location, production process, or measures for pollution prevention and ecological damage prevention of the construction project, the construction entity shall re-submit the environmental impact report or environmental impact statement for approval.
If a construction project commences construction only after five years have elapsed from the date of approval of its environmental impact report or environmental impact statement, such report or statement shall be re-examined by the original approval authority. The original approval authority shall, within 10 days from the date of receipt of the environmental impact report or environmental impact statement, notify the construction entity in writing of the review opinion; if no notification is given within the time limit, it shall be deemed as consent upon review.
No fees shall be charged for the review, approval of environmental impact reports or environmental impact statements of construction projects, or for the filing of environmental impact registration forms.

Article 13 A construction entity may, by means of public tender, select a unit engaged in environmental impact assessment work to carry out the environmental impact assessment of the construction project.
No administrative authority shall designate a unit engaged in environmental impact assessment work for the construction entity to conduct environmental impact assessment.

Article 14 When preparing an environmental impact report, the construction entity shall, in accordance with the relevant legal provisions, solicit opinions from the relevant units and residents in the location of the construction project.

Article 15 The environmental protection facilities required to be constructed in support of a construction project must be designed, constructed, and put into operation simultaneously with the main project.

Article 16 The preliminary design of a construction project shall, in accordance with the requirements of environmental protection design specifications, include an environmental protection chapter, implement measures for preventing and controlling environmental pollution and ecological damage, and the budget estimate for investment in environmental protection facilities.
The construction entity shall incorporate the construction of environmental protection facilities into the construction contract, ensure the progress and funding for the construction of environmental protection facilities, and simultaneously organize the implementation, during the project construction, of the environmental protection countermeasures and measures set forth in the environmental impact report, environmental impact statement, and the approval decision of the approving authority.

Article 17 After the completion of a construction project for which an environmental impact report or environmental impact statement has been prepared, the construction entity shall, in accordance with the standards and procedures prescribed by the competent department of environmental protection under the State Council, carry out acceptance of the supporting environmental protection facilities and prepare an acceptance report.
During the acceptance of environmental protection facilities, the construction entity shall truthfully inspect, monitor, and record the construction and commissioning of the environmental protection facilities of the construction project, and shall not engage in fraud.
Unless the situation requires confidentiality under state provisions, the construction entity shall, according to law, publicly disclose the acceptance report to the public.
Article 18 For a construction project constructed in phases and put into production or use in phases, the corresponding environmental protection facilities shall be accepted in phases.

Article 19 For a construction project for which an environmental impact report or environmental impact statement has been prepared, its supporting environmental protection facilities may only be put into production or use after having passed acceptance; if they have not undergone acceptance or have failed acceptance, they shall not be put into production or use.
After the construction project specified in the preceding paragraph is put into production or use, a post-environmental impact assessment shall be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the competent department of environmental protection under the State Council.

Article 20 The competent department of environmental protection shall conduct supervision and inspection over the design, construction, acceptance, and putting into production or use of environmental protection facilities of construction projects, as well as the implementation of other environmental protection measures determined in the relevant environmental impact assessment documents.
The competent department of environmental protection shall record the environmental illegal information related to the construction project into the social credit archive, and promptly disclose the list of violators to the public.

Article 22 Where, in violation of these Regulations, when preparing the preliminary design of a construction project, a construction unit fails to implement measures for preventing environmental pollution and ecological damage and the investment estimate for environmental protection facilities, fails to incorporate the construction of environmental protection facilities into the construction contract, or fails to carry out post-environmental impact assessment according to law, the competent administrative department of environmental protection at or above the county level in the place where the construction project is located shall order it to make corrections within a prescribed time limit and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan; if it fails to make corrections within the time limit, a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 1,000,000 yuan shall be imposed.
Where, in violation of these Regulations, during the construction process of a construction project, a construction unit fails to simultaneously organize the implementation of the environmental protection countermeasures and measures set forth in the environmental impact report, the environmental impact statement form, and the approval decision of the examination and approval department, the competent administrative department of environmental protection at or above the county level in the place where the construction project is located shall order it to make corrections within a prescribed time limit and impose a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 1,000,000 yuan; if it fails to make corrections within the time limit, it shall be ordered to suspend construction.

Article 23 Where, in violation of these Regulations, a construction project is put into production or use without the supporting environmental protection facilities having been completed, accepted, or having passed acceptance, or where fraud is committed in the acceptance of environmental protection facilities, the competent administrative department of environmental protection at or above the county level shall order corrections within a prescribed time limit and impose a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 1,000,000 yuan; if corrections are not made within the time limit, a fine of not less than 1,000,000 yuan but not more than 2,000,000 yuan shall be imposed; the directly responsible person in charge and other directly responsible persons shall be fined not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan; if major environmental pollution or ecological damage is caused, production or use shall be ordered to stop, or the matter shall be reported to the people's government with approval authority for approval to order closure.
Where, in violation of these Regulations, a construction unit fails to disclose to the public the acceptance report of environmental protection facilities according to law, the competent administrative department of environmental protection at or above the county level shall order disclosure, impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan, and make a public announcement.

Article 24 Where, in violation of these Regulations, a technical institution collects fees from a construction unit or a unit engaged in environmental impact assessment work, the competent administrative department of environmental protection at or above the county level shall order the refund of the fees collected and impose a fine of not less than one time but not more than three times the fees collected.

Article 25 Where a unit engaged in environmental impact assessment work for a construction project commits fraud in the environmental impact assessment work, the competent administrative department of environmental protection at or above the county level shall impose a fine of not less than one time but not more than three times the fees collected.

Article 26 Where any staff member of the competent administrative department of environmental protection engages in malpractice for personal gain, abuses power, or neglects duty, which constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if the act does not constitute a crime, administrative sanctions shall be imposed according to law.

Article 27 For regional development such as river basin development, development zone construction, new urban district construction, and old district reconstruction, an environmental impact assessment shall be conducted when preparing construction plans. Specific measures shall be separately prescribed by the competent administrative department of environmental protection under the State Council jointly with the relevant departments under the State Council.

Article 28 The environmental protection management of marine engineering construction projects shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of the State Council on environmental protection management of marine engineering.
Article 29 The environmental protection management of military facility construction projects shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Central Military Commission.
Article 30 These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
